svg.text: SUB-SLAB HOT WATER PIPE LEAK — EFFECTS ON SLAB-ON-GRADE HOME
Cross-section showing leak damage progression and hidden damage after surface drying
Surface appears dry, but slab, fill, bond layer,
and soil remain saturated. Tile will fail.
The pipe is located in engineered fill dirt ABOVE the natural grade — it is not "underground."
Policy exclusions for underground pipes do not apply to pipes embedded in construction fill above the natural ground surface.
